Without this, the enrichment pass refuses to state any figure not present in the (often stub) original, which produces a structurally correct but hollow guide. 52.topic: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax
facts: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax is phased in by 'qualifying income', which is total gross income from self-employment and property before expenses, not profit.
Sole traders and landlords with qualifying income over £50,000 must use Making Tax Digital for Income Tax from 6 April 2026.
Those with qualifying income over £30,000 join from 6 April 2027.
Those with qualifying income over £20,000 join from 6 April 2028.
The government has stated it will extend the requirement to those with qualifying income over £20,000 by the end of this Parliament.
Qualifying income is assessed for a tax year, and HMRC writes to people it believes are in scope.
Once in scope, you keep digital records and send quarterly updates to HMRC using compatible software, then finalise the year.
Making Tax Digital for VAT already applies to VAT-registered businesses, which is a separate and earlier regime from Making Tax Digital for Income Tax.
